{{Corrupted}} mobs are variants of mobs that generally appear on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.

== Overview ==
Non-[[Runic]] mobs have a {{Green|1%}} chance ({{Green|5%}} during [[Volcanic Eruption]])<ref>
{{Cite Discord
|staff=yes
|url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1547017021756276827
|user=mrkeith
|date=09/08/26, 6:53 PM (EST)
|text=1% default, 5% during volcano eruption, check skipped if mob is already runic}}
</ref> to spawn with the {{Corrupted}} modifier active on the [[Crimson Isle]]. {{Corrupted}} mobs, upon being killed, drop {{Item|Corrupted Fragment}}s alongside {{Item|Sulphur}}.

Additionally, the following modifiers affect the chance for {{Corrupted}} mobs to spawn:

* The {{Item|Totem of Corruption}} will cause all caught [[Sea Creatures]], regardless of location, to be {{Corrupted}}. {{Corrupted}} [[Sea Creatures]] have a chance to drop {{Item|Obfuscated-1}}.
* {{Ench|Corruption}} grants a {{Green|+1%}}-{{Green|5%}} chance to spawn a {{Corrupted}} [[Sea Creature]]. It can be applied to [[Fishing Rods]].
* {{Attr|Infection}} increases the chance of catching {{Corrupted}} [[Sea Creatures]] by {{Green|+0.2%}}-{{Green|2%}}.
* [[Minions]] that have the {{Item|Corrupt Soil}} modifier applied will spawn {{Corrupted}} forms of their respective mobs, and will generate {{Item|Corrupted Fragment}}s and {{Item|Sulphur}}.
** If a {{Item|Super Compactor 3000}} is applied and there is enough space in the minion, {{Item|Sulphur}} will be compacted into {{Item|Enchanted Sulphur}} and {{Item|Enchanted Sulphur Cube}}s.
* {{Gamemode|Stranded}} increases the chance of catching {{Corrupted}} [[Sea Creatures]] by {{Green|+0.1%}} per {{Skill|Fishing|Level}}.

== Trivia ==
* Most mobs can spawn as {{Corrupted}}, with the exception of {{MobSprite|Bladesoul}}, {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}}, {{MobSprite|Barbarian Duke X}}, {{MobSprite|Ashfang}}, {{MobSprite|Ashfang Acolyte}}s, {{MobSprite|Ashfang Underling}}s, {{MobSprite|Ashfang Follower}}s, {{MobSprite|Mage Guard}}s, {{MobSprite|Barbarian Guard}}s, and {{MobSprite|Lord Jawbus}}.
* Prior to an unknown update<!--Probably 0.23.5-->, {{Corrupted}} mobs would spawn with {{Stat|hp|3x}} and deal {{Stat|dmg|2x}}.
* Prior to January 28th, 2025, pairing {{Item|Corrupt Soil}} with an {{Item|Enchanted Hopper}} was a popular money-making method due to the high NPC sell price of {{Item|Corrupted Fragment}}s, which used to be {{c|20}} per before it was reduced to {{c|1}} per. At the time, [[Automated Shipping]] from minions accounted for {{Green|53%}} of all coin generation, with setups using {{Item|Corrupt Soil}} being identified as a major contributor.
